name: BLAST
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, for each hit roll of 6, allocate 2 damage points to another visible fighter within 1" of the target of the attack action.

name: BLESSED
text: When making an attack action against a `VAMPIRE`, `DAEMON` or `THRALL`, increase the Critical Damage characteristic of this weapon by 1.

name: BRACE
text: When determining how many ranged weapons the bearer is equipped with, two weapons with this special rule count as one.

name: CUMBERSOME
text: When the bearer is the target of a melee attack action, decrease their Fight characteristic by 1.

name: ONE-USE
text: This weapon can only be used for one attack action each battle.

name: PARRY
text: When the bearer is the target of a melee attack action, increase their Fight characteristic by 1.

name: PIERCING 1
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, reduce the target's Armour characteristic by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

name: PIERCING 2
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, reduce the target's Armour characteristic by 2 (to a minimum of 0).

name: PIERCING 3
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, reduce the target's Armour characteristic by 3 (to a minimum of 0).

name: POINT-BLANK
text: This weapon may be used for melee attack actions. Use the bearer's Shoot characteristic (decreased by 1) instead of their Fight characteristic for the hit rolls.

name: RELOAD
text: This weapon must be reloaded after being used for an attack action. A fighter can reload one of their weapons with this special rule when making the wait action.

name: TWO HANDED
text: When determining how many melee weapons the bearer is equipped with, this weapon counts as two.

name: UNRELIABLE
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, if any hit rolls result in a 1, all hit rolls are discarded and the attack action ends.

name: WHIPCRACK
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, unless used as an off-hand weapon, the target cannot make reactions.
